subject.title: fix(done): accept ancestor commit when verifying push to shared target branch
subject.author: KayoticSully

diff_summary.note: Original PR was a real fix idea (3-file, +134/-3) but was CONFLICTING/DIRTY against current main, never ran Test/Lint/Build CI against its own diff, had no maintainer approval, and its own ancestry helper had a split fetch/push-URL correctness gap. Superseded by an independently-authored, correctly-scoped 3-file replacement (PR #4420) before merging.

action_plan.summary: PR #4067 is already fully resolved: closed by a maintainer (Bella-Giraffety) on 2026-07-07 as superseded by merged replacement PR #4420 ('fix(done): verify pushed commits against target branch ancestry'), which independently merged to gastownhall/gastown main the same day (commit 4f6b9fe1351741eefd706b95f7420384b8de5609). This is the third bead dispatched against this PR; the first (gt-od73/radrat) correctly diagnosed both the merge-conflict/no-approval blocker and a split fetch/push-URL correctness gap in the original PR's own ancestry helper, and filed a maintainer fixup rather than merging or requesting contributor changes; the second (gt-q88c/pipboy) built the fix, tying the ancestry check to the same push-target remote the tip was read from (resolving the split-URL gap), and carries its own complete 15+5+5 PR Sheriff evidence trail in bead comments. This pass re-verifies every load-bearing fact from first principles -- merge ancestry, fix/regression-test presence and correct wiring on current upstream/main (verified via a fresh detached worktree, not the review branch's own diverged fork checkout), CI results, attribution, related-issue disposition, and prior-dispatch history -- rather than trusting the close comment or the gt-q88c record at face value, and confirms no further action is needed on the PR itself. One directly-on-point open GitHub issue (#4188) is identified and recommended for closure as fixed, with the chronology of its most recent comment independently checked against the fix commit. Sheriff wrote no code, opened no PR, and took no new GitHub-visible action (no comments, labels, or merges) in this pass.

Body: introduce git.VerifyCommitOnRemoteBranch to accept tip-or-ancestor instead of exact-tip equality for shared target branches, route the three done.go shared-target-branch call sites through it, retain exact-tip VerifyPushedCommit for owned-branch verification, plus a concurrent-push regression test. A real, narrowly-scoped 3-file bug fix idea (+134/-3), but (per R03/R05 below) not safe to merge as its own diff.

research_legs.lens: The split fetch/push-URL correctness gap in the original PR's own helper
research_legs.summary: gt-od73's R05 finding: the PR's proposed VerifyCommitOnRemoteBranch read the branch tip via PushRemoteBranchTip (which may query the push URL) but then fetched/checked origin/<branch> from the fetch side -- in split fetch-URL/push-URL remotes (the normal case for a polecat working against a fork with an upstream push guard) this could verify against the wrong repository/ref or a stale remote-tracking branch. This was assessed as a genuine technical blocker, not a style nit, and is what the replacement had to fix (see R08/R09).

research_legs.lens: Fix content actually present and correctly wired on current upstream/main
research_legs.summary: git show upstream/main:internal/git/git.go shows both VerifyPushedCommit (exact-tip, preserved) at line 2095 and the new VerifyPushedCommitReachableFromPushTarget at line 2116. Reading the latter's body: it reads the tip via PushRemoteBranchTip, and on mismatch fetches g.pushTarget(remote) (the same push-side remote/URL the tip was read from) before running git merge-base --is-ancestor -- directly fixing the split fetch/push-URL gap gt-od73's R05 flagged in the original PR's own helper (which mixed push-side tip reads with fetch-side ancestry checks). git show upstream/main:internal/cmd/done.go confirms all three shared-target-branch call sites (no-MR close at line 1088, direct merge at line 1234, late direct merge at line 1334) route through the new ancestor-aware verifier, while the owned feature-branch push path (line 2082) correctly retains the exact-tip VerifyPushedCommit.

pre_implementation_reviews.lens: technical-defect disposition (the actual reason #4067 wasn't merged as-is)
pre_implementation_reviews.summary: The original PR's defect was substantive, not cosmetic: its ancestry helper mixed a push-URL tip read with a fetch-side ancestry check, which is a genuine correctness gap on split fetch/push-URL remotes (the normal polecat-against-fork-with-upstream-guard case). Confirmed the merged replacement's VerifyPushedCommitReachableFromPushTarget fetches from the same push-target remote the tip was read from (R09), directly closing that gap, and that dedicated split-URL regression tests exist and pass (R11). This is the correct fix for the defect gt-od73's review identified, not a narrower or riskier substitute for the original bug-fix intent.

Initial draft risked treating gt-q88c's own bead-comment record and GitHub's mergedAt/mergeCommit fields, plus the #4188 close-comment cross-reference, as sufficient proof by themselves -- the same gap the #4103/#4124 precedents' P05 findings flagged. Correction applied: added an independent git-level ancestry check (git merge-base --is-ancestor), independent content-level and wiring checks via git show/git grep against upstream/main for the verifier and all its call sites (not just the two touched non-test files claimed in the PR body), an independent go test run of the actual regression suite (including split-URL cases) inside a fresh detached upstream/main worktree, and -- going beyond the #4103 precedent -- an independent git-level chronology check (merge-base --is-ancestor in both directions) to verify whether the #4188 Aug-10 field comment represented a live regression or a stale pre-fix binary, rather than assuming either reading. All now recorded in checker.txt/evidence.json (R08-R11, R15). schema fields set to mode='confirmed_prior_disposition' / closure state='closed', matching the fact that the replacement has already merged and the original PR is already closed.

cleanup_first.rationale: PR #4420's merged fix adds one new push-target-aware ancestor verifier, invoked only at the three call sites that legitimately need tip-or-ancestor semantics (no-MR close, direct merge, late direct merge on a shared target branch) -- no compatibility shim, retry layer, or duplicate mechanism beside the pre-existing exact-tip verifier, which is correctly left untouched for owned-branch and self-performed-push contexts. The flow also correctly diagnosed and fixed a genuine technical defect (split fetch/push-URL ancestry mismatch) in the original contributor's own proposed helper rather than merging it as-is or bandaiding around it. This review pass itself introduces no code.
